title: festuca balcanica
intro: Festuca balcanica, commonly known as Balkan fescue, is a type of grass species belonging to the genus Festuca. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Festuca balcanica include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
